definitions.gloss: to be humid, to be sultry

examples.japanese: {芋|いも}を{蒸|む}して{食|た}べる。
examples.english: To steam sweet potatoes and eat them.

examples.japanese: {魚|さかな}は{焼|や}くより{蒸|む}した{方|ほう}がおいしい。
examples.english: Fish tastes better steamed than grilled.

examples.japanese: {蒸|む}し{暑|あつ}い{日|ひ}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: The hot and humid days continue.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{蒸|む}すので、{窓|まど}を{開|あ}けて{風|かぜ}を{入|い}れる。
examples.english: It's humid in summer, so I open the windows to let the breeze in.

notes:
{蒸|む}す means to steam (cooking) or to be humid (weather).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive: {野菜|やさい}を{蒸|む}す (to steam vegetables)
- Intransitive: {今日|きょう}は{蒸|む}す (it's humid today)

COOKING USES:
- {野菜|やさい}を{蒸|む}す: to steam vegetables
- {肉|にく}を{蒸|む}す: to steam meat
- {蒸|む}し{料理|りょうり}: steamed dishes

WEATHER USES:
- {蒸|む}し{暑|あつ}い: hot and humid, muggy
- {蒸|む}す{日|ひ}: a humid/muggy day

RELATED WORDS:
- {蒸|む}し{器|き}: steamer (cooking tool)
- {蒸|む}し{焼|や}き: steam-grilling
- {蒸|む}しパン: steamed bread/bun
- {茶碗蒸|ちゃわんむ}し: savory egg custard
- {蒸気|じょうき}: steam
